test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD - GA & GK (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: With reference to the constitutional provisions regarding Rajya Sabha, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The Vice-president of India is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Attorney-General of India is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The President of India is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
The Prime Minister of India is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Vice-president of India is ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vice-president of India is** ex officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• The post of Vice President of India is the second-highest constitutional post in the country.
 
• Their tenure is of five years duration.
 
• He may continue in office till the end of this period, till he assumes the office of his successor.
 
• According to the Constitution, the Vice-President can be removed from office by a resolution of the Rajya Sabha which is passed by a majority of the then members of the Rajya Sabha and which the Lok Sabha agrees to.
 
• A resolution for this purpose can be presented only when a notice to this effect has been given at least 14 days in advance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**​ 

 
• The Election Commission of India conducts elections for the post of Vice President.
 
• To act as the Executive President in accordance with Article 65 of the Constitution in the absence of the President due to the absence, death, or any other reason.
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, whose work is conducted by the Rajya Sabha.
 
• There is no provision for impeachment in the Constitution to remove the Vice President of India.
